description: A load cell amplifier that digitizes a Wheatstone-bridge load cell's output over a 2-wire interface.
how_to_use: VCC/GND power, DT (serial data) and SCK (serial clock) are the 2 pins the microcontroller drives — a bit-banged HX711-proprietary protocol, NOT the board's real SPI bus despite the 'SCK' name coincidence (deliberately not marked as a protocol leg here, to avoid falsely triggering this project's SPI-bus protection). E+/E-/A+/A-/B+/B- are the load-cell/Wheatstone-bridge connection points, not microcontroller-facing pins.

plain.what: A helper board for a load cell — the part that turns weight into a signal, so you can build a scale.
plain.how: The load cell's 4 wires go to E+, E−, A−, A+. VCC, GND, DT and SCK go to the Arduino.
